feature: Content Studio creator operations and engagement

flows.name: Creator catalog governance
steps: Open the authenticated Content Studio catalog
Review destination counts and creator-focused columns
Select a catalog row and open shared bulk editing
Confirm display area, owner, reviewer, and review-date fields
flows.expectedOutcome: Creators can understand and govern one catalog while engagement remains truthful about tracked and untracked content

checks: Creator columns and bulk governance controls remain usable
The 390px layout separates title, controls, and catalog cards

claims.description: One catalog exposes destination, governance, and engagement operations
Aggregate reads and bounded bulk writes are app-admin-only and fail loudly
Dates, engagement labels, manager choices, and shared table behavior have focused regression coverage
